player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id}. Kuna wasa da Wasan Memory. Manufar ku ita ce daidaita nau'i-nau'i na katunan a kan allon, fiye da abokin adawar ku. A lokacin da kuka juya, zaɓi katunan biyu don juyawa ta hanyar shigar da lambobi da lambobi na farko da na biyu kamar '[0 1 1 0]', inda katin farko yake a jere 0 da shafi na 1, kuma katin na biyu yana cikin jere 1 da shafi na 0. Idan katunan biyu sun dace, kuna samun maki kuma katunan suna ci gaba da fuskantarwa. Idan basu dace ba, ana jujjuya katunan da fuska, misali '.'. Wasan ya ƙare lokacin da duk nau'i-nau'i suka dace.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsarin motsawa mara inganci. Mai kunnawa {player_id} bai amsa da ingantaccen shugabanci a cikin masu kusurwa ba.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ba daidai ba. Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya zaɓi matsayi na waje.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Ba daidai ba. Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya zaɓi katin guda sau biyu.
invalid_move.already_matched: Ba daidai ba ne. Mai kunnawa {player_id} ya zaɓi ɗaya ko duka katunan da aka riga aka daidaita.

game_message.cards_match: Katunan da Dan wasa {player_id} ya zabi a wuraren [{r1} {c1}] da [{r2} {c2}] sun dace!
game_message.cards_no_match: Katunan da Dan wasa {player_id} ya zabi ba su dace ba. Katunan a wuraren [{r1} {c1}] da [{r2} {c2}] sune {pos1} da {pos2} bi da bi.

outcome.draw: Ƴan wasa biyu sun yi daidai da adadin jojin katin daidai.
outcome.turn_limit: An kai iyakar juyawa. Wasan ya ƙare. Mai kunnawa 0 ya ci {score_0} maki, Mai kunnawa 1 ya ci {score_1} maki.
